name: HVAC Designer
tagline: Simulate a building's chiller/AHU plant loop and check it against NBC compliance.
description: Simulates a building's HVAC plant loop — chillers and AHUs feeding zone banks — for a chosen system type (DX, VRF, or chiller), checks it against an NBC gate checklist, and produces a client report. The tool's own interface still carries an 'uncalibrated' status flag.

page.objective: Give a quick, visual read on whether an HVAC system choice meets code before detailed design.
page.problem: Comparing HVAC system types (DX, VRF, chiller) against code compliance normally needs a separate calculation pass per option.
page.solution: One building input animates the plant loop for the chosen system and checks it against an NBC gate checklist live. The tool is still marked uncalibrated on its own screen.

highlights.headline: Animates a chiller/AHU plant loop and scores it against NBC compliance gates.
points: Animates chilled-water flow from chillers through AHUs to zone banks in real time.
Scores the design against an NBC compliance checklist and compares system types side by side.
The interface itself is still flagged 'uncalibrated' — treat results as a working simulation, not a certified calculation.
